name: Trilinear Interpolation on Sparse Voxel Octree
definition: A method to sample scalar or vector fields stored in leaf nodes of a Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) using trilinear interpolation. It maps 3D points to grid coordinates, identifies the 8 surrounding voxel neighbors, retrieves their payload values via the octree structure, and computes the weighted sum.
summary: Trilinear Interpolation on Sparse Voxel Octree samples scalar or vector fields from octree leaf nodes by retrieving eight surrounding voxel values and computing their weighted sum.
